name: Memory pairs
description: Turn the cards two at a time and find the matching pairs. Trains visual and working memory.
instructions:
The cards are face down. Tap two of them to turn them over.
If they match they stay face up, otherwise they turn back.
Remember where they are and find all the pairs!
instructionsKids:
Turn two cards at a time and find the matching friends!
Remember where you saw them. 🧠
